tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs nag 'gros su bkod pa bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo badzra bhai ra wa ye/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dir 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs 'jug pa bde ba zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang yo byad ji skad bshad pa rnams tshogs par byas nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsams la/ rdor dril byin brlab gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥ sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po/ de'i nang gi shar du bruṃ las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha gaus mtshan pa/ lhor aṃ las byung ba'i khyi'i sha kus mtshan pa/ nub tu dzri las byung ba'i glang po che'i sha das mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las byung ba'i rta'i sha has mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i mi'i sha nas mtshan pa/ shar lhor lam las byung ba'i dri chen bis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las byung ba'i rakta ras mtshan pa/ nub byang du baṃ las byung ba'i byang sems dkar po shus mtshan pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las byung ba'i rkang mar mas mtshan pa/ dbus su baṃ las byung ba'i dri chu mūs mtshan pa/ de dag gi steng du oṃ dkar po aḥdamar po hūṃ sngon po gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar te thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bar gyur/ yi ge gsum las 'od zer rim pa bzhin du 'phros pas/

sku rdo rje gsum gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje rnams bkug nas yi ge gsum la rim gyis thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhu bas/ hūṃ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs/ āḥs bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis mang bor sbar zhing sbel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod de/ de nas sngon 'gro mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hrīḥṣtīḥ sa bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ dri/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ pā dyāṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ gandhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ nai waṃ dya āḥhūṃ/ oṃ shapta āḥhūṃ/ de nas gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ de nas phyogs skyong spyan 'dren tshul bsdus pa ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa bkug ste phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa las skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar po 'od kyi spu gu can rnams su gyur/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya kṣe ya/ ya kṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bhū tsa ra naṃ/ ya pā tā la tsa ra ya/ mān khe tsa ra ya/ ta pūr ba ni gā naṃ/ ka dakṣi ṇa dī gā ya/ hūṃ pashtsi ma naṃ/

phaṭa ud ta ra ti gā ya/ oṃ i/ hrīḥya/ ṣtīḥb/ wi kṣi/ kri ko/ tā e/ na a/ na de/ hūṃ bhyoḥ phaṭa sarba bhu de bhyaḥ zhes pa gsum gyis bsngo/ /oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā dyāṃ/ gan dhe/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ nai wi dya/ shapta pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ da sha dika oṃ āḥhūṃ/ btags la nang mchod 'bul/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan lam du/ /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ 'byung po ro langs ci bgyi bka' nyan tshogs /phyi nang skyong ba'i dam can ma lus la/ /bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis bdud cing mchis/ /zhes bstod la/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gi dge ba'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa dang*/ de'i bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya brjod de/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes pa nasabazod mdzad rigs/ oṃ āḥ badzra muḥ phyogs skyongs 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hrīḥṣt+rīḥs bsangs*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ zhes pa nas oṃ shapta āḥhūṃ/ gi bar sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar dang*/ oṃ rū pa āḥhūṃ de bzhin du sbyar te/ shapta/ gan dhe/ ra sa/ sparsha āḥhūṃ gis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon dang bcas pa byin gyis brlab/ de nas spyi 'gro ltar maṇḍal 'dod na bsdus pas chog ste nges par dgos pa min/ rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas byed na/ dkon chog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /tshigs bcad gcig gi rjes su/ /rang gi spyi bor baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/

lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje bsnyems ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ yab rdo rjai skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po/ /de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsams la/ yig brgya nyer gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cing*/ /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/

/'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag go /zhes gsungs nas/ rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ de nas tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa gsal bar byas/ de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying kar thim par gyur/ de nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ /dpa' bo mchog gi spyod yul can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa phyag bya/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rtsa rtsi ka dkar mo/ /phag mo sngon mo/ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ gau ri ljang ku phyag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa rnams ky-is mchod par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥṣīḥhaḥs mchod yon dang*/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis zhabs bsil/ oṃ wi kri tā na na duṣtaṃ sa twa da ma ka gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ yis dri/ oṃ ku ma ra rū pi ṇe dza dzaḥhūṃ phaṭa/ kyis me tog /oṃ hrīḥhaḥhai phaṭa kyi bdug spos/ oṃ dīpta lo tsa na wi kri tā na na ma hā a ṭṭa ṭṭa hā sa ni di ni dībta ya swā hās mar me/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūṃ swāhās lha bshos/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ gis rol mo rnams dbul/ /de nas/ sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ skyes shing byung ba rnams ni bsal/ /mi byed par yang spyan sngar brjod/

/de bzhin bsod nams rjes yi rang*/ /bdag gis bder 'gror yongs su bsngo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis dgrol/ byang chub gnas la dgod par bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dang bas bsten par bgyi/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa nas/ dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces brjod la/ sdom pa bzung nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig pa'i dga' ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gis mi bskyod pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o/ /snyam du tshad med pa bzhi bsgom ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhāḥ sarba dharmāḥ swa bhā wa shud dhonyahaṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rang dang tshogs zhing gi lha dang de dag las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba/ bdag med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ ces bdag med pa'i lta ba dran par bya ste ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhir rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs su 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje gur/ gur gyi 'og rwa ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'bar ba'i rang bzhin/ bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu/ bskal ba 'jig pa'i me lta bu'i kha dog sna lnga'i me dpung phyogs bcur 'phro bar gyur/ par bsgom ste/ bsrung 'khor thun mong ba'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor ni/ 'di ltar/ rwa ba'i dbus su bhūṃ las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rab tu 'bar ba g.yas bskor du 'khor ba/ rtsibs bcu lte ba dang bcas pa/ lte ba'i nang dang rtsibs la cung zad ma reg pa'i gnas rnams su sna tshogs padma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan gsum gsum gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gnod mdzes rgyal po sku mdog mthing ga mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis padma dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing*/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stobs kyi bzhugs pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i huṃ gi 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i khro bo bcu zhal du bcugs nas zhu ba rdo rje'i laṃ nas yum gyi padmar zhugs pa'i thig le bcu las huṃ ring po bcu dang de las khro bo bcur gyur pa'i gshin rje'i gshed sngon po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang rdo rje tho ba/ g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/

hūṃ padma las spros te/ shar rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la g.yon brkyangs kyis 'khod/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang be con/ g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hūṃ= lho rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la g.yon brkyangs kyis 'khod/ rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dmar mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis= lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang padma/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hūṃ= nub rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la= bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis= lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hū= byang rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la g.yon brkyangs kyis 'khod/ 'dod rgyal mthing ga mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ /mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis= lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hūṃ= me mtshams kyi rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la= dbyug sngon can sngon po mi bskyaud pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis= lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hūṃ= bden bral gyi rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la= stobs po che sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis= cing lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hūṃ= rlung mtshams kyi rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la= mi g.yo ba mthing ga mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/

mthing dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis= lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis padma dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ hūṃ= dbang ldan gyi rtsibs kyi steng gi gdan la= gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ljang ser mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ljang ser dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis= lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang 'khor lo/ /g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hūṃ= gtso bo'i steng gi cung zad tsam gyi mdun gyi gdan la= rdo rje sa 'og mthing ga mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis padma dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ hūṃ padma las spros te gtso bo'i 'og gi cung zad tsam gyi rgyab kyi gdan la g.yon brkyangs kyis 'khod/ /bcu gcig po thams cad kyang mche ba gtsigs shing zhal so so yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser 'bar zhing gyen du 'khyil ba/ 'khor lo dang rna cha la sogs pas brgyan cing sna tshogs pa'i sprul gyi rgyan can/ bdud dang bgegs thams cad rtsad nas 'byin pa'i stobs dang ldan pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing 'jigs su rung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba sprin ltar 'khrigs pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod par gyur/ bsrung 'khor thun mong ba tsam la byed na phyogs bcur 'phro bar gyur/ ces pa'i mtshams nas/ rwa ba'i dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' zhes sogs dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe/ rang nyid gnod mdzes su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing*/

lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa gyen du 'greng ba 'og tu phra zhing stod yangs pa/ 'og zur nas paṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs padma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar gyi rwa dkar/ lho'i rwa ser/ nub kyi rwa dmar/ byang gi rwa ljang*/ dbus kyi lte ba sngon pos brgyan pa/ bsam mo/ /lte ba'i dbus su bhruṃ las 'khor lo bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa las byung ba'i rnam snang dkar po dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi bsgo bzhi ba/ phyi rol nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa'i rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mdzes par phub pa/ rtse mo rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa'i nang gi shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo ba/ pha gu'i steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa la dril bu dang rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du mda' yab padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can la/ ba dan dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ sgrub thabs 'dir tshig bsdus pa'i dbang du mdzad na phyi'i steng gi zla bzhi la gdugs bzhis brgyan pa zhes ma gsungs kyang rang nyid kho nas 'don pa'i tshe sbyar chog

/rtsig pa'i mtha' nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos/ 'gram stegs kyi rnam par bskor ba la/ lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa rnams 'khod nas mchod pa phyed pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang*/ 'og gi phyi nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam pu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo/ /de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ 'dir rtabs kyi g.yas g.yon du sogs mi 'byung yang 'dod na byas chog pa ni sngar ltar ro/ /rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu/ gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod brgyad na/ na ga ge ser gyi shing la sogs pa'i shing brgyad/ de'i rtsa bar brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ /rtse mor rdzu 'phrul chen po ba glang po che'i gdong ba can la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ thugs rje'i chu brgyad de la gnas pa'i nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu brgyad/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la sgrogs pa la sogs pa'i sprin brgyad/ /ye shes kyi me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ gzhan yang keng rus dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa'i ro dang*/ shing la dpyangs pa dang*/ skyes bu za ba dang*/ mtshon gyis phug pa la sogs pa dang*/ bya rog dang bya rgod dang khy-i dang ce spyang dang*/ seng ge dang stag la sogs pa dang*/ ca co sgrog pa'i ro langs dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po la sogs pa rnams kyis 'jigs su rung ba/ grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta ba/ gcer bu skra bshig pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ cang te'u dang thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa thod pas spyi bor brgyan pa/ rgod cing dur khrod du 'jug pa sogs kyis/ shin tu ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i dur khrod rnams kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi re mig dgu pa'i dbus su/

yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag la cung zad dmar ba'i mdog can gyi steng dang*/ nang gi phyogs gzhan gsum dang*/ sgo bzhir sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ nang gi shar dang grwa bzhi dang phyi'i grwa bzhir/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan zung re re/ bsgom ste rten bskyed pa'o/ /gdan dbus ma'i steng du a yig dang po las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su chu las chu bur gyi tshul du/ dhīḥ ser po las byung ba'i ral gri dbus su dhīḥ sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po yid tsam khros pa phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon gyis glegs bam thugs kar bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ ral ba'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bsam mo/ /de'i thugs kar āḥ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rnam snang la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ rdo rje rnon po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i khro bo dang*/ sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i rig pa rnams spyan drangs te/ 'jam dpal dang bcas pa nyi ma la zhugs pa las 'od zer gyis dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad khyab pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khrau bo dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ nas/ hūṃ la zhugs pa las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po/ rtse dgu ba rwa shin tu gdengs pa 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa/ lte ba la hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las rdo rje phra mo'i gzugs spraus pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i chogs rnams spros te/

nam mkha'i khams thams cad til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang ba/ nyi ma la gnas pas sems can rnams smin par byas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed thob par byas pa dang lhan cig tu 'dus te rdo rje la thim par gyur par bsam mo/ /zla ba nyi ma rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stobs kyis bzhugs pa/ khams gsum po za bar nus pa ha ha zhes sgrog cing sngags 'dril pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa khro gnyer can/ khro gnyer gyi 'gram du/ smin ma dang spyan 'jig pa'i dus ltar 'bar ba/ skra khams ser gyen du brjes pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub byed pa/ 'jigs pa rnams kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ pheṃ ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ mi'i khrag dang zhag dang rkang dang chil bu za ba/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod pa bskam po lngas thod byas shing*/ mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i thod ba'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ sprul nag po'i mchod phyir thogs dang mi rus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha la sogs pa'i rus pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gsus pa che/ gcer bu'i gzugs can/ smin ma dang rdzi ma dang sma ra dang ba spu rnams dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing*/ rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can shing tu khros pa rwa rnon po can/ de'i steng ma rwa gnyis kyi dbus kyi zhal dmar po/ rab tu 'jigs pa zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po yid tsam khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyi bor ral ba lnga dang ldan pa/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yas kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ /de'i g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ser po/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yon gyi zhal dang po dkar po/ de'i g.yas zhal dud ka /g.yon zhal nag po/

zhal rnams shin tu khros pa/ zhal dgu po thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa mgo g.yas dang*/ spu phyir bstan te lag pa dang rkang pa'i pags pa g.yon pa nas brkyangs te 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug /gnyis pa na bhi dhi pā la/ gsum pa na gtun shing*/ bzhi pa na chu gri/ lnga pa na ka ṇa ya/ drug pa na dgra sta/ bdun pa na mdung*/ brgyad pa na mda'/ dgu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu pa na dbyug to/ /bcu gcig pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bcu gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ /bcu gsum pa na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ bcu bzhi pa na rdo rje tho ba/ bco lnga pa na ral gri/ bcu drug pa na cang te'u bsnams shing*/ lhag ma g.yon gyi dang po na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ gnyis pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gsum pa na phub/ bzhi pa na rkang ba/ lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na gzhu/ bdun pa na rgyu ma/ brgyad pa na dril bu/ dgu pa na lag pa/ bcu pa na dur khrod kyi ras/ bcu gcig pa na skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ bcu gnyis pa na me thab/ bcu gsum pa na thod tshal/ bcu bzhi pa na sdigs mdzub/ bco lnga pa na 'phan rtse gsum pa/ bcu drug pa na rlung ras bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi dang pos mi/ gnyis pas ma he/ gsum pas glang*/ bzhi pas bong bu/ lnga pas rnga mong*/ drug pas khyi/ bdun pas lug /brgyad pas wa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos bya rgod/ gnyis pas 'ug pa/ gsum pas bya rog bzhi pas ne tso/ lnga pas khra/ drug pas bya chen po/ bdun pas khyim bya/ brgyad pas bzhad mnan pa/ tshangs pa dang dbang po dang khyab 'jug dang drag po dang*/ gzhon nu gdong drug dang log 'dren dang zla ba dang nyi ma rnams kha sbub tu byas te/ zhabs 'og tu mnan nas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po yid tsam khros pa/

phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon gyis glegs bam thugs kar bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ bsam mo/ /de'i bang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod bskam lngas dbu brgyan cing bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ āḥlas byung ba'i ze 'bru bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pa rjes chags kyi brgyal bya'o/ /de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyi lcags kyus mkha' khyab kyi sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas rang gi zhal du bcug /thugs kar 'od du zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar zhugs pa'i thig le cha gcig /bhruṃ dang de yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par gyur/ thig le cha gcig gdan de rnams kyi steng du cha bcu bdun du gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ nang gi shar du kṣe las 'khor lo kṣes mtshan pa/ lhor ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa/

nub tu me las padma mes mtshan pa/ byang du da las ral gri das mtshan pa/ shar sgor ya las tho ba yas mtshan pa/ lho sgor tsa las dbyug pa tsas mtshan pa/ nub sgor ni las padma nis mtshan pa/ byang lhor ra la ral gri ras mtshan pa/ nang gi shar lhor dza las 'khor lo dzas mtshan pa/ lho nub tu sa las rdo rjes sa mtshan pa/ nub byang du do las padma dos mtshan pa/ byang shar du ru las ral gri rus mtshan pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni ra'i yi ge bzhi rnams 'od zer 'phro zhing 'du ba/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag so bzhi/ zhes pa nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyal gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod bskam lngas dbu brgyan cing bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po dkar sngon dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum= lhag ma g.yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum= lhag ma g.yas gnyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum=

lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ shar sgor tho ba gshin rje'i gshed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum= lhag ma g.yas gnyis tho ba sngon po rwa nyi shu pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje'i gshed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis padma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub sgor padma gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ dmar sngo dkar pa'i zhal gsum= lhag ma g.yas gnyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang nor bu 'dzin pa byang sgor ral gri gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum= lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ yab brgyad po thams cad thod pa bskom po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ 'bar ba'i mche ba bzhi bzhi rab tu gtsigs nas/ ljags rnam par 'dril zhing 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba/ mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa brgyan cing*/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas pa/ padma dkar pos mgul rgyan bya shing*/ stobs rgyu ljang gus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ska rags byas shing*/ padma chen po dkar pos zhabs rdub byas pa/ klu brgyad po thams cad phud kyi sgra sgrog cing*/ lce gnyis pa/ dug dang ldan pa'i mche ba'i phreng ba can no/ /nang gi shar lhor tsa rtsi ka dmar mo shin tu skem zhing drag tu khros pa/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi= rang 'dra'i/ yab la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/

lho nub tu phag mo sngon mo phag gdong can/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar po zhi ba'i cha byad can/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang shar du gau rī ljang gu sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ yum bzhi ga'ang thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni ra'i yi ge bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhir gyur/ par bsam mo/ /de nas mdal 'byin ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣt+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ gtso bo yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus/ rang dang yum la thim par gyur/ oṃ dzi na dzika gti mug gshin rje'i gshed yab yum bskul/ /dpag tu med pa'i gyur/ yum gyi/ = phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus/ nang gi shar gyi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ ratna dhā+-ika/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed yab yum/ = sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal dang ser sna sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ = lho'i gdan la 'khod/ oṃ āḥro li ka /'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed = 'dod chags sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ = nub kyi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ pra dzñā dhṛka /phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed/

= phrag dog sbyangs/ bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ byang gi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ ud ga ra dhrika /tho ba gshin rje'i gshed/ = phung po'i bdud bcom/ dad pa'i stobs la bkod/ = shar sgo'i dbus su 'khod/ oṃ daṇḍa dhrika /dbyug pa gshin rje'i gshed/ = nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs la bkod/ lho sgo'i dbus su 'khod/ oṃ padma dhrika/ padma gshin rje'i gshed/ = 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ dran pa'i stobs la bkod/ nub sgo'i dbus su 'khod/ oṃ khaṅga dhṛka/ ral gri gshin rje'i gshed/ = lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la bkod/ = /byang sgo'i dbus su 'khod/ = /oṃ mo ha ra ti/ tsa rtsi ka yab yum/ = sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med la bkod/ = /nang gi shar lho'i grwar 'khod/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra ti/ phag mo yab yum/ = chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med la bkod/ = lho nub kyi grwar 'khod/ oṃ rā ga ra ti/ dbyangs can ma yab yum/ = me'i khams/ = dga' ba tshad med la bkod/ = nub byang gi grwar 'khod/ oṃ badzra ra ti/ gau ri yab yum/ = rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med la bkod/ = byang shar gyi grwar 'khod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thod pa bzhi bskul/ = yul drug gi dri ma sbyang*/ slar 'dus/ phyi'i grwa bzhir 'khod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhal yas khang*/ = snod kyi skyon sbyangs/ bde ba la gnas pa rnams brtan par byas/ gcig tu 'dus/ dam tshig gi gzhal yas khang la thim par gyur par bsam mo/ /bdag bskyed rkyang pa la phyogs skyong dgug bskyed skabs 'dir mi byed pas skye mched sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su kṣiṃ dang 'khor lo las/ rdo rje mig dkar po dkar sngo dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/

rna ba gnyis su dzriṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje rna ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ snar khaṃ dang rin po che las rdo rje sna ser po ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ lce'i rtsa bar raṃ dang padma las rdo rje lce dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dpral bar kaṃ dang ral gri las rdo rje lus ljang gu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ lte bar saṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rjai yid dkar po dkar sngo dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang pad zla la gnas pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i nang du hūṃ dang rdo rje las thugs rdo rje nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i gzhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su āḥdang padma las gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i dbus su/ oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ = lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha chogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥhaḥ.oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

ces pa nas/ oṃ shapta āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ 'od zer gyis bkug ste/ thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i thugs rdo rje la thim par gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ 'od zer gyis bkug ste gsung rdo rje lha tshogs rnams lha rnams kyi mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta wā ka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ 'od zer gyis bkug ste/ sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams lha rnams kyi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nga yin no snyam du nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas spyan 'dren rgyas par byed 'dod na hūṃ yig las 'od zer spro zhing lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la/ dzaḥ'ajam dpal rang bzhin chos rnams kun gyi dngos/ /gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin/ /dus kyi khams bzhin thugs rje 'gro 'ong bral/ / sprul ba 'gro dang bral ba gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid mi mnga' yang*/ /chu zla bzhin du gar dmigs der snang bas/ /deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /las byed sprul pa gshin rje'i 'khor dang bcas/ /'di ni dba' bo gcig pa'i dbang du byas la/ /'dir gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /sbyor bar gsungs pa ltar legs/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ hrīḥhā bho ma hā kro dha ā ga tstsha a ga tstsha asmār pū dza pra ti gṛhna ntā pra sā da meḥdhīḥmā na ku ru swāhā/ bsdu na tshigs bcad bzhag /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jig byed lha bcu gsum gyi ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

oṃ hrīḥṣt+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ khro bo spros te phyi 'brang gi bgegs tshar bcad la bsrung*/ oṃ hrīḥṣt+rīḥhaḥzhes sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags kyis dam tshig pa so so'i spyi bor dgug /oṃ daṇḍa hūṃ/ gis dam tshig pa so so la gzhug /oṃ padma paṃ/ gyis dam tshig pa so so dag dbyer med du bcing*/ oṃ khaṅga hoḥ sa dbang du bya'o/ /de nas oṃ hrīḥhā bho zhes sogs phyag rgya dang bcas te/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥṣt+ṝḥhaḥ sogs kyi chod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis spros pa'i lha mo tsa rtsi ka la sogs pa rnams kyis shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ zla ba lta bu'i bum pa dkar po bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba bzung nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis ni/ /dag pa lha yi chus dbang bskur/ /zhes gsung zhing spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ /dbang gi chus lus thams cad gang*/ /dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo'i rtsa zhal gyi dbu la mi bskyod pa/ lha gzhan shar dang shar lho ba rnams la rnam snang*/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin 'byung*/ nub dang nub byang ba rnams 'od dpag med/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /mchod pa rgyas par na/ rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing*/ /sme ba'i rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ /sri zhu'i tshul gyi yon chab 'dis/ /bde gshegs rnams la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ ya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/

rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing*/ /sme ba'i rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ /srid zhu'i tshul gyi zhabs bsil 'dis/ /bde gshegs rnams la zhabs khrus gsol/ /oṃ ya mānta ka= pā dyāṃ pra ti tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ rgyal ba rnams ni yon tan mchog gi sku/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i ngad ldan/ /sgyu ma'i chos la ye shes dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chags rdul mi mnga' yang*/ / bdag cag srid zhu gus pa'i tshul gyis su/ /dri mchog gtsang mar bshams te phul ba yis/ /bsod nams yan lag yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ ya mānta ka= gandhe= rgyal ba= byang chub yan lag rgyan gyi me tog mdzes/ /sgyu ma'i =rang bzhin= bdag cag= me tog= /bsod nams= oṃ= puṣpe= de bzhin du sbyar te/ /ye shes pho brang mtshan dpe'i me tog spos/ /bdug spos= dhu paṃ= ma rig mun dang bral ba'i ye shes bdun gyi gsal/ /snang gsal= ā lo ke= nor bdun yon tan chog shes bdud rtsi'i zas/ /bshos bzang = ne wi dya= bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston cing*/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /shapta= yang na oṃ ya mānta ka sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa'am/ oṃ hrīḥṣtiḥhaḥ sogs kyis mchod/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan dag /gzugs mchog tshogs kyis gang ba yang*/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po la/ /zhum pa med par bcas te 'bul/ oṃ= rū pa= de bzhin du sbyar te/ sgra brnyan= shapta= dri mchog= gandhe= ro mchog= ra sa= reg mchog= spar sha pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de nas/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /zhes sogs kyis mchod pa'am min kyang rung*/ nang mchod ni/ oṃ mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/

/chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i zhal du= ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i= la li ta badzra'i= a mo gha badzrī= ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i= /padma badzrī= dī pāṃ ka ra rakṣi ta'i= rwa lo tsā rdo rje grags kyi= rwa chos rab kyi= rwa ye shes seṅge'i= rwa 'bum seng ge'i= rje btsun rgā lo'i= rong ba shes rab seng ge'i= bla ma ye shes dpal ba'i= chos rje don grub rin chen gyi= chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i= /mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal= /gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyu bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ hrīḥṣt+rī'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra bettā li= oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ dzi na dzika= / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ btag la dbul/ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams gyi zhal du= chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams ky-i zhal du= gzhan yang sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos thos pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la bsten pa/ bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsten zhing bsgrubs pa'i bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi= /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dbang po dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ klu la sogs pa rnam kyi= gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang sems can thams cad lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/

rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣt+ṝḥwi kṛ= oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod de/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag /oṃ a mraṃ ta swā da na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ rang gi lus la gnas pa'i mgron thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ gsang mchod byed na/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po lce lnga pa/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ āḥlas byung ba'i ze 'bru bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ bsams la/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba rtsam ste/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma kohaṃ/ rang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba skyes/ dkyil 'khor ba'i lha thams cad kyis kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong ste/ bde ba chen po dang de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas/ gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas dgyes par gyur/ de nas bstod pa brgyas par na/ 'jam dpal gser mdog ma dang*/ bsdu na/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab*/ /chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /phyag 'tshal 'jam dpal dpa' gyur rdzogs pa khyod/ /chos kyi sku la byams sdang mi mnga' yang*/ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje thabs kyis khro rgyal skur bstan pa/ /'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod de 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis gtso bo la brag cha'i dbyangs bzhin du bstod par bsam mo/ /de nas gtso bos 'khor rnams la bstod par bsams la/ gshin rje'i gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/

/ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /rdo rje thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ / gshin rje'i gshed por rab 'jigs pa/ /rdo rje gsung dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po las kun pa/ /rdo rje sku dang rab mtshungs pa/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod nas/ yang 'khor rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gtso bo la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po khyod/ sangs rgyasathams cad gcig bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod de/ de nas dpyad bsgom dang 'jog bsgom gnyis kyi sgo nas gsal snang bsgrub cing nga rgyal brtan pa la bslab par bya'o/ /bsgom pas skyon dag pa dran par bya ste/ /de ltar zhal dgu ni gsung rab yan lag dgu/ rwa gnyis ni bden pa gnyis/ phyag so bzhi dang sku gsung thugs te so bdun gyi byang phyogs so bdun/ /zhabs bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug /yum dang sbyor ba ni bde ba chen po rgyas pa/ mig la sogs pa ni dngos grub brgyad dang*/ bya rgod la sogs pa ni dbang phyug brgyad dag pa yin la/ gcer bu ni sgrib g.yogs med pa dang*/ skra gyen du brjes pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang ston pa'o/ /de dag gi don mdor bsdu na/ gtan la dbab pa'i gzhi/ gsung rab yan lag dgu'i brjod bya kun rdzob sgyu ma dang*/ don dam nam mkha' lta bu khong du chud pa'i lam byang phyogs so bdun yin la/ lam de'i gtso bo don dam rtogs pa la ni/ stong nyid bcu drug gi rtogs pa yod de/ de yang thabs bde ba chen po dang dbyer med par zhugs pa'o/ /lam des bgrod pa'i 'bras bu dngos grub thun mong ba dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi gtso bo ni/ sgrib pa zad pa'i myang 'das so/ /zhes rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par shar ba'i skus/ de ltar mtshon pa go bar byed pa'o/ /de nas phreng ba 'byin brlab bya tshul ni/ phreng ba hrīḥṣt+ṝḥs bsangs swa bhā was stong par sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las me las padma mes mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po zhes pa nas thod pa thugs kar 'dzin cing = 'khor lo 'dzin pa de'i mig gnyis su kṣiṃ/ rna bar dzriṃ/ snar khaṃ/ lcer raṃ/ dpral bar kaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ /dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan par gyur/ /oṃ ā ro li arghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ oṃ ā ro li ka oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis nang mchod/ 'dod chags rdo rje zhes sogs kyi bstod/ oṃ ā ro lika hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo 'dod chags gshin rjai gshed zhu ba las byung ba'i bgrang phreng khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo'i phreng ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsam/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra byung bar gyur bar bsams te/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya kṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

zhes pa ni rtsa sngags sam phreng sngags so/ /oṃ hrīḥṣt+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni las kyi sngags so/ /oṃ ya mān ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bedta lī ā gatstsha ā gatstsha hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ yum gyi sngags so/ /oṃ dzi na dzika hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā ro lika hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pradzñā dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ muṅga ra dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ daṇḍa dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ padma dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaḍga dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dāe ṣa ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rā ga ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags so/ /grangs ni/ bsnyen pa la/ rtsa sngags 'bul/ las sngags sum 'bul/ snying po la bdun 'bum bya bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mthar gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya brjod cing*/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul na/ byin gyis brlabs te/ cung zad rgyas par na/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las mdun du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten bar bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum zhes pa nas/ byang shar du gau ri yab yum/ phyi'i grwa bzhir mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi zhes ye shes pa'i rten brten pa bskyed/ phyogs skyong gsal 'debs rgyas par na lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ /oṃ hrīḥṣt+ṝḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sarba duṣtaṃ inta ā di na sa pā ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥswāhā/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje gshed lag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/

phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te bkug nas/ dkyil 'khor phyi'i phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa ni/ shar du dbang bo dmar ser glang po che la zhon pa/ mig stong pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de'i g.yon du nye dbang nag po nam mkha' lding la zhon pa/ g.yas gnyis srub shing dang 'khor lo/ /g.yon gnyis dung dang nor bu ko stu bha thogs pa/ lhor gshin rje nag po ma he la zhon pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po sprul la zhon pa sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du lus ngan ser po sha rgyas pa/ gter la gnas pa/ g.yas sa bon gyi grong khyer dang g.yon ne'u le thogs pa/ de'i g.yon du tshogs bdag glang sna dkar po byi ba la zhon pa/ g.yas gnyis bgrang phreng dang dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis la phug dang la du 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa/ ral ba'i thor cog can/ rtse gsum dang thod pa thogs pa/ lag pa gnyis kyis gau ri la 'khyud pa/ mer me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ srin por srin po sngon po ra la zhon pa khro zhing rngams pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha du ba'i mdog can ri dwags la zhon pa/ lag pa gnyis kyis rlung ras 'dzin pa/ steng du zla ba dkar po ku mu da'i steng na gnas pa/ /lag pa gnyis kyis ku mud 'dzin pa/ nyi ma dmar po rta mchog bdun la zhon pa/ lag pa gnyis kyis padma 'dzin pa/ tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi pa ngang ba la zhon pa/ g.yas pas spyi blugs dang mi 'jigs pa/ g.yon pas dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo padma la gnas pa/ g.yas dbang bor khas len ring*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ thags bzang ris sngon po shing rta la zhon pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon sdigs mdzub can rnams te/

de dag gi 'khor du srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣt+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ sarba duṣtaṃ ind+ra ā di na sa pa ri wā rā na kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed phyag na phur bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying ga dang mgrin pa dang rkang pa'i bar du phur bus btab pas/ grub pa'i bcud len grub pa bzhin du/ skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su kṣiṃ/ rna bar dzriṃ/ zhes pa nas/ hūṃ sngon po mtshan par gyur ces skye mched byin brlab bya/ de nas/ oṃ hrīḥha bho ma hā nas/ de nyid la thim par gyur ces ye shes pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing*/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas te/ ljags byin gyis brlabs nas gtor ma gzhung bzhin phul te mchod bstod kyang bya/ de nas phyogs skyong rnams kyi ljags byin gyisabarlabs nas rtsa sngags sngon du btang ba'i gtor ma 'bul tshul sngar bzhin bya'o/ /gshed gsol 'og nas 'chad pa ltar bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul tshul shin tu bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis dpal rdo rje 'jig byed lha bcu gsum gyi ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pas bskor ba spyan drangs te/ phyogs skyongs rnams skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug par las dpal rdo rje 'jig byed zhes pa nas/ skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las nas/ rnams su gyur/ 'das gtor 'bul rjes su/ rtsa sngags brjod cing bhū tsa ra naṃ/ zhes sogs kyis sngar bzhin phul nas 'phrin las bcol te gshegs gsol bya'o/

/las gshin la gtor 'bur bsdus pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra ā karṣ+ya ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kā la ru pa tsa muṇḍi sa pā ri wa ra nas/ khā hi gsum gyis thun mong du phul nas mchod yang na so sor 'bul lo/ /bstod pa ni/ 'jam dpal bka' mnyan zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gam/ de'i mjug tu sdang ba'i dgra dang zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ ma rnyed zhes sogs kyis bzod pa gsol/ /gshed rje gshed kyi yig brgya brjod cing gshegs/ /'das ma 'das thun mong du gshegs gsol byed na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra muḥ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes pa rnams gshegs shing dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron gzhan rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /med na 'dir yang mchod bstod bya/ nyer brgyad byed na/ bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams dang yum rang la thim/ /rang dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ ye shes sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i zhabs kyu u ni ha la/ ha ni ha'i mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur pa'i mig gnyis su kṣiṃ nas hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur bsams la/

smon lam shis brjod bya'o/ /'di yang co ne'i shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan re gnyis la phan ched 'jug pa bde bar bsgrigs pa ste/ gzhan la phan thogs par gyur cig /dge legs 'phel/ maṅgalaṃ// //

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs nag 'gros su bkod pa bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 164-- PAGE 163- -PAGE 130-
